decisions.reason: Because this waterproof lined safety shoe range was only visible at launch and not thereafter, the market test appears to have resolved uncertainty without showing enough distinct value to justify keeping an incremental core-line variant open.

As this electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe was mentioned only in 2019, management should treat the missing follow-on presence as evidence that the option did not warrant further commitment relative to the firm's many nearby core products and development opportunities.

Since this safety shoe series also appeared only in its launch year, the prudent real-options choice is to abandon it and reallocate resources to stronger established lines or newer projects with better upside.
